picks.title: Introducing GWM Worlds 2, a Playable World Model
picks.excerpt: Runway's GWM Worlds 2 generates explorable, playable environments in real time — a shift from clip generation toward navigable worlds that previs and virtual production could stage inside.
picks.rationale: Biggest model-level shift in the pool: generation moves from fixed clips to navigable worlds, which changes how previs and virtual production could be blocked.

picks.title: Nura Studios Opens Showcraft AI Production Platform to the Public
picks.excerpt: Showcraft takes a story from script, shot list or concept through storyboard, animatic, animation and final edit in one connected environment; the tools behind 'Rainbow Hollow' and 'Astro Burn' are now open to everyone.
picks.rationale: The pipeline that shipped two finished series is now open access — an end-to-end script-to-edit environment anyone can test this week.

picks.title: Avid Media Composer 2026.8 is now available
picks.excerpt: Media Composer 2026.8 ships with deeper Avid Content Core integration and expanded agentic workflow intelligence, including automated content prep for editors, alongside big third-party storage changes.
picks.rationale: A shipping release in the industry-standard NLE that hands content prep to agents — editors start from an assembled bin instead of raw rushes.

picks.title: 'HOPE' making of trailer includes Alicia Vikander and Michael Fassbender mocap sessions
picks.excerpt: A making-of trailer for 'HOPE' shows Alicia Vikander and Michael Fassbender's performance-capture sessions and how the mocap data drove the film's fully digital characters.
picks.rationale: Rare on-set look at how performance capture actually drives fully digital characters, a craft counterweight to the week's prompt-driven tool releases.

picks.title: We Found a Weird Seedance Character Hack
picks.excerpt: Curious Refuge breaks down a face-grid technique for holding character consistency across Seedance-generated shots — a practical continuity workaround for AI-assisted narrative work.
picks.rationale: Character consistency is the standing blocker in AI narrative work; this is a concrete face-grid trick a filmmaker can apply to the next shot.
